description: This file contains CLI-related functions for the Playwright project, including driver execution, server setup, and browser server launch, with associated imports and utility functions.

methods.name: printApiJson
methods.description: Outputs the contents of the api.json file as a JSON string.

methods.name: runDriver
methods.description: Initializes the Playwright driver, sets up message transport, and handles process signals.

methods.name: runServer
methods.description: Starts a Playwright server with specified options and logs the WebSocket endpoint.

methods.name: launchBrowserServer
methods.description: Launches a browser server for a specified browser name, optionally using a config file.
